pipelines.name: CI

steps.name: Verifying Installation
steps.run:
for attempt in {1..15}; do
  if curl -fsS http://localhost:2368 | grep -qi ghost; then
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 2
done

echo "Ghost site did not become reachable after install"
exit 1

steps.name: Recording running process pid
steps.run:
if [ ! -f ghost/.ghostpid ]; then
  echo "Ghost pidfile was missing before stop"
  exit 1
fi
BEFORE_PID="$(cat ghost/.ghostpid)"
if [ -z "$BEFORE_PID" ]; then
  echo "Ghost pidfile was empty before stop"
  exit 1
fi
echo "LOCAL_BEFORE_PID=$BEFORE_PID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Stopping Ghost instance
steps.run:
node ./cli/bin/ghost stop -d ghost
for attempt in {1..15}; do
  pidfile_removed=true
  site_stopped=true

  if [ -f ghost/.ghostpid ]; then
    pidfile_removed=false
  fi

  if curl -fsS http://localhost:2368 > /dev/null; then
    site_stopped=false
  fi

  if [ "$pidfile_removed" = true ] && [ "$site_stopped" = true ]; then
    exit 0
  fi

  sleep 2
done

echo "Ghost local process did not fully stop within the retry window"
exit 1

steps.name: Verifying Restart
steps.run:
for attempt in {1..15}; do
  if [ -f ghost/.ghostpid ] && \
    [ "$(cat ghost/.ghostpid)" != "$LOCAL_BEFORE_PID" ] && \
    curl -fsS http://localhost:2368 | grep -qi ghost; then
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 2
done

echo "Ghost local process did not restart with a new pid"
exit 1

steps.name: Prepare CLI
steps.run:
cp -r ./cli /opt/cli
chmod 755 /opt/cli
cd /opt/cli
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
sudo ln -s /opt/cli/bin/ghost /usr/local/bin/ghost

steps.name: Setting up Ghost instance
steps.run:
ghost install \
  -d /opt/ghost-e2e-test \
  --auto \
  --no-prompt \
  --url http://cli-testing.ghost.org \
  --db mysql \
  --dbhost 127.0.0.1 \
  --dbuser root \
  --dbpass ${{ matrix.password }} \
  --dbname ghost-mysql

steps.name: Normalizing install permissions
Recording running service pid
steps.run:
BEFORE_PID="$(sudo systemctl show -p MainPID --value ghost_cli-testing-ghost-org)"
if [ -z "$BEFORE_PID" ] || [ "$BEFORE_PID" = "0" ]; then
  echo "Ghost service did not expose a running MainPID before stop"
  exit 1
fi
echo "STOP_START_BEFORE_PID=$BEFORE_PID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Stopping Ghost instance
steps.run:
cd /opt/ghost-e2e-test
ghost stop
for attempt in {1..15}; do
  service_stopped=true
  site_stopped=true

  if sudo systemctl is-active --quiet ghost_cli-testing-ghost-org; then
    service_stopped=false
  fi

  if curl -fsS http://cli-testing.ghost.org > /dev/null; then
    site_stopped=false
  fi

  if [ "$service_stopped" = true ] && [ "$site_stopped" = true ]; then
    exit 0
  fi

  sleep 2
done

echo "Ghost service did not fully stop within the retry window"
exit 1

steps.name: Verifying Restart
steps.run:
for attempt in {1..15}; do
  AFTER_PID="$(sudo systemctl show -p MainPID --value ghost_cli-testing-ghost-org)"

  if sudo systemctl is-active --quiet ghost_cli-testing-ghost-org && \
    [ -n "$AFTER_PID" ] && \
    [ "$AFTER_PID" != "0" ] && \
    [ "$AFTER_PID" != "$STOP_START_BEFORE_PID" ] && \
    curl -fsS http://cli-testing.ghost.org | grep -qi ghost; then
    exit 0
  fi

  sleep 2
done

echo "Ghost service did not come back with a new pid after restart"
exit 1

steps.run:
docker run -d --name mysql84 \
  --network host \
  -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=root \

steps.name: Wait for MySQL 8.4
steps.run:
until docker exec mysql84 mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -uroot -proot --silent 2>/dev/null; do
  sleep 2
done

steps.name: Resolve Ghost update versions within supported major
Download pinned Ghost archives
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$UPDATE_ARCHIVE_DIR"
npm pack ghost@"$UPDATE_FROM_VERSION" --pack-destination "$UPDATE_ARCHIVE_DIR"
npm pack ghost@"$UPDATE_TO_VERSION" --pack-destination "$UPDATE_ARCHIVE_DIR"

steps.name: Setting up Ghost instance from archive
steps.run:
ghost install \
  -d "$UPDATE_DIR" \
  --archive "$UPDATE_ARCHIVE_DIR/ghost-$UPDATE_FROM_VERSION.tgz" \
  --auto \
  --no-prompt \
  --url "$UPDATE_URL" \
  --db mysql \
  --dbhost 127.0.0.1 \
  --dbuser root \
  --dbpass root \
  --dbname ghost-update-mysql

steps.name: Normalizing install permissions
Recording running service pid before update
steps.run:
BEFORE_PID="$(sudo systemctl show -p MainPID --value "$UPDATE_SERVICE")"
if [ -z "$BEFORE_PID" ] || [ "$BEFORE_PID" = "0" ]; then
  echo "Ghost service did not expose a running MainPID before update"
  exit 1
fi
echo "UPDATE_BEFORE_PID=$BEFORE_PID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Verifying Update
Generating an owner password
steps.run:
# Ghost rejects passwords from its insecure password blocklist, so
# this is generated rather than hardcoded
OWNER_PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -hex 16)"
echo "::add-mask::$OWNER_PASSWORD"
echo "OWNER_PASSWORD=$OWNER_PASSWORD" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Prepare CLI
steps.run:
cp -r ./cli /opt/cli
chmod 755 /opt/cli
cd /opt/cli
pnpm install --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile
sudo ln -s /opt/cli/bin/ghost /usr/local/bin/ghost

steps.name: Setting up source instance (Ghost v${{ matrix.source_major }})
steps.run:
mkdir "$SOURCE_DIR"
chmod 775 "$SOURCE_DIR"
ghost install ${{ matrix.source_major }} \
  -d "$SOURCE_DIR" \
  --auto \
  --no-prompt \
  --url "$SOURCE_URL" \
  --db mysql \
  --dbhost 127.0.0.1 \
  --dbuser root \
  --dbpass root \
  --dbname ghost_e2e_source

steps.name: Setting up target instance (Ghost v6)
steps.run:
mkdir "$TARGET_DIR"
chmod 775 "$TARGET_DIR"
ghost install "$TARGET_MAJOR" \
  -d "$TARGET_DIR" \
  --auto \
  --no-prompt \
  --url "$TARGET_URL" \
  --db mysql \
  --dbhost 127.0.0.1 \
  --dbuser root \
  --dbpass root \
  --dbname ghost_e2e_target

steps.name: Normalizing install permissions
Disabling staff device verification
steps.run:
# Both instances are driven over the Admin API with a password, which 2FA would block
for dir in "$SOURCE_DIR" "$TARGET_DIR"; do
  cd "$dir"
  ghost config set security.staffDeviceVerification false
  ghost restart
done

steps.name: Setting up blog owners
steps.run:
node /opt/cli/scripts/e2e-api.js setup "$SOURCE_URL" "$OWNER_EMAIL" "$OWNER_PASSWORD" "Source blog"
node /opt/cli/scripts/e2e-api.js setup "$TARGET_URL" "$OWNER_EMAIL" "$OWNER_PASSWORD" "Target blog"

steps.name: Reading staff access tokens
steps.run:
SOURCE_TOKEN="$(node /opt/cli/scripts/e2e-api.js token "$SOURCE_URL" "$OWNER_EMAIL" "$OWNER_PASSWORD")"
TARGET_TOKEN="$(node /opt/cli/scripts/e2e-api.js token "$TARGET_URL" "$OWNER_EMAIL" "$OWNER_PASSWORD")"
echo "::add-mask::$SOURCE_TOKEN"
echo "::add-mask::$TARGET_TOKEN"
echo "SOURCE_TOKEN=$SOURCE_TOKEN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
echo "TARGET_TOKEN=$TARGET_TOKEN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Verifying Import
steps.run:
cd "$TARGET_DIR"
ghost export "$TARGET_EXPORT"
node /opt/cli/scripts/e2e-api.js assert-post "$TARGET_EXPORT" "$POST_TITLE"
curl -fsS "$TARGET_URL" | grep -qi ghost

steps.name: Debugging Failure
steps.run:
journalctl -u ghost_cli-source-testing-ghost-org -n 100 || true
journalctl -u ghost_cli-target-testing-ghost-org -n 100 || true

pipelines.name: Publish to npm

steps.name: Resolve publish mode
steps.run:
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
  echo "mode=${{ inputs.mode }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "tag=${{ inputs.npm_tag }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "manual=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "mode=publish" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "tag=latest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "manual=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Resolve release commit
steps.run:
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
  echo "is_release_commit=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

if ! git rev-parse HEAD^ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Unable to inspect the previous commit for release detection"
  exit 1
fi

if ! git diff --unified=0 HEAD^ HEAD -- package.json | grep -qE '^[+-][[:space:]]+"version":'; then
  echo "is_release_commit=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

if [[ ! "$HEAD_COMMIT_MESSAGE" =~ ^chore\(release\):[[:space:]]+(.+)$ ]]; then
  echo "package.json version changed, but HEAD is not a release commit"
  exit 1
fi

echo "is_release_commit=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "version=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Check if version is already published
steps.run:
LOCAL_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
echo "version=$LOCAL_VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

if [ "${{ steps.publish_mode.outputs.manual }}" != "true" ] && [ "${{ steps.release_commit.outputs.is_release_commit }}" != "true" ]; then
  echo "should_publish=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

RELEASE_VERSION="${{ steps.release_commit.outputs.version }}"
if [ -n "$RELEASE_VERSION" ] && [ "$LOCAL_VERSION" != "$RELEASE_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "Release commit version $RELEASE_VERSION does not match package.json version $LOCAL_VERSION"
  exit 1
fi

NPM_VERSION=$(npm view ghost-cli version 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0.0")
if [ "${{ steps.publish_mode.outputs.manual }}" = "true" ] || [ "$LOCAL_VERSION" != "$NPM_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "should_publish=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "should_publish=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Upgrade npm for trusted publishing support
Publish to npm
steps.run:
PUBLISH_ARGS=(--access public --tag "${{ steps.publish_mode.outputs.tag }}" --provenance)
if [ "${{ steps.publish_mode.outputs.mode }}" = "dry-run" ]; then
  PUBLISH_ARGS=(--dry-run "${PUBLISH_ARGS[@]}")
fi
npm publish "${PUBLISH_ARGS[@]}"

steps.name: Create git tag
steps.run:
TAG="v${{ steps.check.outputs.version }}"
if git ls-remote --tags origin "$TAG" | grep -q "$TAG"; then
  echo "Tag $TAG already exists on remote, skipping"
else
  git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
  git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
  git tag -a "$TAG" -m "$TAG"
  git push origin "$TAG"
fi

steps.name: Create GitHub release
steps.run:
TAG="v${{ steps.check.outputs.version }}"

if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release $TAG already exists, skipping"
  exit 0
fi

# The tag immediately before this one
PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v[0-9]*' --sort=-version:refname | grep -v -- '-' | grep -v "^${TAG}$" | head -n 1)
if [ -n "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
  echo "Previous tag: $PREV_TAG"
  node scripts/release-notes.js "$PREV_TAG" "$TAG" > /tmp/release-notes.md
else
  echo "::warning::No previous tag found — using the fallback release notes"
  echo "This release contains fixes for minor bugs and issues reported by Ghost users." > /tmp/release-notes.md
fi

cat /tmp/release-notes.md
gh release create "$TAG" --title "$TAG" --notes-file /tmp/release-notes.md
